```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

departments <- c(
  "Accountancy", 
  "Economics", 
  "Entrepreneurship", 
  "Finance", 
  "Information Systems & Analytics", 
  "Marketing", 
  "Management"
)

urls <- c(
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Accountancy/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Economics/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Entrepreneurship/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Finance/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Marketing/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Management/all"
)

dept_list <- list()

for (i in 1:length(departments)) {
  
  dept_page <- rvest::read_html(urls[i])
  
  dept_page |> 
    rvest::html_elements("tr > td:nth-child(3) a") |> 
    rvest::html_text2() -> names
  
  dept_page |> 
    rvest::html_elements("tr > td:nth-child(3) a") |> 
    rvest::html_attr("href") |> 
    rvest::url_absolute(base = urls[i]) -> websites
  
  dept_page |> 
    rvest::html_elements("tr > td:nth-child(3)") |> 
    rvest::html_text2() -> full_person_text
  
  positions <- stringr::str_remove(full_person_text, fixed(names)) |> stringr::str_trim()
  
  dept_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    department = departments[i],
    name = names,
    position = positions,
    website = websites
  )
}

fsb_directory <- dplyr::bind_rows(dept_list)

head(fsb_directory)
```
